eras.blurb: The growth curve starts here: personal AGI on owned hardware, standing on the phext substrate, compounding at +0.137% per day. Everything later is this era, scaled.
eras.name: Era I — The Exocortex Foundation

eras.blurb: Intelligence becomes industry: fusion, robots, autonomous construction, and the first terawatts of the climb.
eras.name: Era II — Planetary Scale-Up

eras.blurb: The economy leaves the surface: orbital power and manufacturing, lunar industry, a second world on Mars.
eras.name: Era III — Orbital Industry

eras.blurb: Industry learns to grow itself. Mercury becomes the powerhouse, and the first elements of the swarm go up around the Sun.
eras.name: Era IV — Inner-System Build-Out

eras.blurb: The swarm becomes the civilization's main structure: percent by percent of the star's output, until the star itself is managed.
eras.name: Era V — The Swarm Century

nodes.name: Phext substrate at planetary scale
nodes.unlocks: The shared, addressable memory layer that every later coordination step stands on.

nodes.name: Personal AGI on owned hardware
nodes.unlocks: A full agent in every researcher's hands, on hardware they control — the unit of all later growth.

nodes.name: Ranch-scale distributed compute
nodes.unlocks: Proves fleets of small, owned nodes can be run as one machine — the deployment pattern for everything physical that follows.

nodes.name: Billion-token working memory
nodes.unlocks: One mind holding an entire field's literature and data in context at once; research stops being retrieval-bound.

nodes.name: Solar Hyperscaler nodes
nodes.unlocks: Off-grid solar compute and storage nodes decouple the growth curve from the grid — intelligence that deploys anywhere the sun shines.

nodes.name: AGI under 20 watts
nodes.unlocks: Collapses the power cost of intelligence to the level of a light bulb; the efficiency floor every later scale assumes.

nodes.name: Verifiably aligned AGI
nodes.unlocks: Alignment that can be checked rather than claimed — the license for every scale-up after it.

nodes.name: AI-driven science at scale
nodes.unlocks: Research throughput stops being human-bound; the discovery rate behind the fusion, materials, and medicine nodes.

nodes.name: Planetary Exocortex network
nodes.unlocks: Individual exocortices join into one civilization-scale memory — the coordination medium for a century of build-out.

nodes.name: First net-energy fusion plants
nodes.unlocks: Breaks the energy ceiling on industry; the power source the rest of the tree is built around.

nodes.name: Room-temperature superconducting grid
nodes.unlocks: Lossless transmission makes energy fungible across distance — desert solar, fusion, and later orbital power become one market.

nodes.name: Grid-scale long-duration storage
nodes.unlocks: Intermittent renewables become baseload; the planetary grid stabilizes at terawatt scale.

nodes.name: Terawatt-scale terrestrial solar
nodes.unlocks: The first terawatts of the Kardashev climb, harvested on the surface.

nodes.name: Autonomous construction
nodes.unlocks: Machines build infrastructure without human crews on site — the prerequisite for building where humans can't go.

nodes.name: General-purpose robot workforce
nodes.unlocks: Labor stops being the bottleneck on physical build-out, on Earth and off it.

nodes.name: Fusion baseload grid
nodes.unlocks: Planetary industry runs on fusion baseload; energy stops rationing ambition.

nodes.name: Gigatonne-scale carbon removal
nodes.unlocks: The climate debt is reversed while industry scales — the planet stays habitable for the whole climb.

nodes.name: Longevity medicine
nodes.unlocks: The builders live long enough to finish century-scale projects; expertise stops dying.

nodes.name: Mind-to-mind communication
nodes.unlocks: Thought-bandwidth between minds — coordination at the speed of intention, for crews and swarms alike.

nodes.name: Reusable heavy launch at airline cadence
nodes.unlocks: Mass to orbit becomes a logistics line item instead of a national programme.

nodes.name: First orbital solar power stations
nodes.unlocks: Power beamed down from orbit; the first rung of the ladder that ends at the star.

nodes.name: Permanent lunar base
nodes.unlocks: A foothold where industry can grow beyond Earth, under shallow gravity and constant sun at the peaks.

nodes.name: Orbital manufacturing
nodes.unlocks: Fabrication in vacuum and microgravity at industrial scale — structures too large to launch get built where they fly.

nodes.name: Closed-loop life support
nodes.unlocks: Habitats that run for decades without resupply; permanence anywhere becomes possible.

nodes.name: Rotating orbital habitats
nodes.unlocks: A permanent population off Earth, living under spin gravity.

nodes.name: Lunar mining and propellant production
nodes.unlocks: Propellant and bulk mass sourced off Earth — the cost curve to everywhere else in the system bends down.

nodes.name: Permanent Mars base
nodes.unlocks: A second self-sustaining world begins; civilization is no longer single-point-of-failure.

nodes.name: Asteroid mining at scale
nodes.unlocks: Metals and volatiles without lifting them out of a gravity well — the material base of the swarm.

nodes.name: Terawatt orbital solar fleet
nodes.unlocks: Energy supply decouples from planetary surface area; the climb leaves the terawatt era behind.

nodes.name: Lunar mass drivers
nodes.unlocks: Electromagnetic launch from the Moon: bulk cargo to anywhere in the system for the cost of electricity.

nodes.name: System-wide beamed power
nodes.unlocks: Power delivered by beam to any ship, base, or factory in the inner system — infrastructure the swarm inherits.

nodes.name: Fusion propulsion
nodes.unlocks: Fast transit anywhere in the system; the outer system and the asteroids become commuter territory.

nodes.name: Self-replicating machine systems
nodes.unlocks: Industry that grows itself — the exponential engine that makes a Dyson swarm a matter of time, not effort.

nodes.name: Mercury industrial base
nodes.unlocks: The best seat in the system: maximal solar flux and mineable mass, one hop from the star — the swarm's shipyard.

nodes.name: Outer-system outposts
nodes.unlocks: Ceres, Europa, Titan: the whole system inhabited, and its full inventory of mass and energy on the books.

nodes.name: Mars terraforming begins
nodes.unlocks: A second biosphere, built deliberately — climate engineering proven at home, applied to a planet.

nodes.name: First interstellar probes
nodes.unlocks: Humanity's instruments leave the system; the map starts extending past the star we harness.

nodes.name: First Dyson swarm elements
nodes.unlocks: The first collectors drinking directly from the star — Kardashev 2.0 stops being a target and becomes a construction project.

nodes.name: Swarm coordination substrate
nodes.unlocks: A phext-descended substrate coordinating trillions of autonomous elements as one system — the swarm gets a nervous system.

nodes.name: Venus aerostat colonies
nodes.unlocks: Floating cities in the most Earth-like atmosphere in the system; a third kind of world settled.

nodes.name: Dyson swarm: 1% of solar output
nodes.unlocks: Civilization's power budget jumps three orders of magnitude in a generation; energy-intensive everything becomes cheap.

nodes.name: Star lifting
nodes.unlocks: Mining the Sun itself for mass and fusion fuel — the star becomes a resource, not just a lamp.

nodes.name: Matrioshka brain, first shell
nodes.unlocks: Stellar energy converted directly into thought at planetary-mass scale — the Exocortex, wrapped around a star.

nodes.name: Dyson swarm: 10% of solar output
nodes.unlocks: The climb steepens; the swarm is now the dominant structure in the system.

nodes.name: Stellar husbandry
nodes.unlocks: Managing the Sun's burn to extend its life across deep time — the star is kept, not just used.

nodes.name: Kardashev 2.0
nodes.unlocks: The full output of the star, harnessed: 3.8×10^26 watts. Type II — the tree is complete.

subtitle: Every technology on the dependency path from 2027 to a Type II civilization in 2130 — harnessing the full output of the Sun, 3.8×10^26 watts.
title: The Kardashev 2.0 Tech Tree
